big_story.headline: RBI Defends Rupee Amid Oil Pressure
big_story.subhead: CENTRAL BANK INTERVENES IN CURRENCY MARKETS AS SURPLUS BANK LIQUIDITY FADES
paragraphs: The Reserve Bank of India likely intervened in foreign exchange markets on Wednesday to support the local currency against relentless pressure from elevated global oil prices. Traders noted that mild capital inflows and central bank intervention helped cap the rupee's losses as crude strains mounted. The Indian rupee faced mounting pressure as investors kept a close eye on upcoming policy decisions from the US Federal Reserve.

The central bank's actions come as India's record bank cash surplus begins to fade due to regulatory measures designed to curb speculative bets against the currency. Rising energy costs continue to weigh on import bills, creating persistent demand for US dollars among domestic buyers. Despite these international headwinds, central bank commentary indicates that the broader Indian economy maintains strong underlying resilience.

Market participants are closely watching the interplay between currency intervention and domestic money market liquidity in the coming sessions. As the central bank absorbs rupees to sell dollars, banking system liquidity could tighten further, impacting short-term money market rates. Investors will remain cautious as global policy shifts and oil price fluctuations shape market sentiment.
big_story.pullbox: Central bank interventions and tightening bank liquidity reflect the delicate balance required to shield the domestic currency from global oil shocks and shifting capital flows.

explains.title: What is Forex Intervention?
paragraphs: Forex intervention occurs when a central bank actively buys or sells its national currency in foreign exchange markets to influence its exchange rate. By purchasing rupees using foreign currency reserves, the central bank helps prevent sudden depreciation.

While intervention can calm volatile currency markets, selling foreign reserves directly reduces rupee liquidity in the banking system. Central banks must balance stabilizing exchange rates with maintaining adequate liquidity in commercial banks.

Bengaluru-based startup Simplismart has raised $14 million in a fresh funding round, bringing the company's valuation to $100 million. The investment was led by tech giant NVIDIA alongside Dallas VC and other prominent venture partners. Simplismart develops infrastructure software aimed at optimizing and accelerating artificial intelligence model deployment.

The funding underscores growing global interest in Indian enterprise software startups focused on foundational AI infrastructure. With backing from key semiconductor and venture heavyweights, Simplismart plans to expand its product offerings and serve expanding demand for efficient compute orchestration.

story_1.headline: Maruti Suzuki Q2 Net Profit Drops 26%
paragraphs: Maruti Suzuki India reported a 26% decline in its second-quarter net profit to ₹2,466 crore as higher operational costs weighed heavily on profitability. The carmaker faced margin pressures alongside mark-to-market losses during the period. Profitability was also impacted by ongoing West Asia conflict disruptions affecting supply channels.
Despite the drop in bottom-line profits, total revenue grew 26% during the quarter. Investors are keeping a close watch on how the company manages rising cost pressures moving forward.

story_2.headline: Simplismart Secures $14 Million in Funding
paragraphs: Bengaluru-based artificial intelligence startup Simplismart has raised $14 million in a fresh funding round led by NVIDIA and Dallas VC. The investment round values the Indian technology company at $100 million.

The capital injection highlights growing global investor appetite for Indian AI infrastructure and platform developers. Simplismart plans to utilize the funds to scale its operations and technology stack.

story_3.headline: India and Mexico Begin Trade Deal Talks
paragraphs: India and Mexico have signed terms of reference to formalize negotiations for a new trade agreement. The proposed deal aims to safeguard Indian automobile and textile exports from potential 50% Mexican import duties.

geopolitics.headline: Piyush Goyal Eyes Major Export Push to China and ASEAN
paragraphs: Union Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal highlighted that India could emerge as a major exporter to China and ASEAN nations. Speaking on strategic foreign trade, Goyal stressed leveraging regional demand to boost Indian industrial output. The initiative aims to capitalize on shifting global trade routes across key Asian markets.

However, Indian businesses face structural challenges, including trade deficits with China and regulatory hurdles in ASEAN markets. Balancing trade flows will require strategic negotiations to protect domestic industries while expanding market access. The success of this export push hinges on enhancing competitive logistics and bilateral agreements.

big_story.headline: Sensex Jumps 1,534 Points as Soft Crude Oil Prices Boost Markets
big_story.text: Indian equities rallied sharply as the Sensex surged by 1,534 points following a decline in global crude oil prices. Lower energy costs provide relief for India's import-heavy economy and reduce inflationary pressure on domestic industries. The market surge highlights how sensitive domestic investor sentiment remains to international commodity price movements.

big_story.headline: Coal India H1 Capex Surges 27% to ₹7,966 Crore, Surpassing Target
big_story.text: State-run miner Coal India reported a 27% year-on-year increase in its first-half capital expenditure, reaching ₹7,966 crore and surpassing its outlay target. The aggressive spending underscores India's push to upgrade mining infrastructure and boost domestic coal production to meet growing energy demand. Accelerating capex remains crucial to strengthening national energy security and supporting economic growth.

venture_vault.headline: Cent Secures $15 Million Series A to Scale Preventive Healthcare
venture_vault.text: Healthtech startup Cent raised $15 million in a Series A funding round led by Blume Ventures and South Park Commons to build its preventive health platform. The capital infusion will allow the platform to expand its wellness offerings across India. Strengthening preventive healthcare infrastructure is vital to reducing chronic disease burdens across the country.

venture_vault.headline: Nova Spectral AI Secures ₹21 Crore for Domestic Infrared Chips
venture_vault.text: Five-month-old startup Nova Spectral AI raised ₹21 crore to develop India's homegrown infrared vision chip technology. The investment reflects growing venture interest in deep-tech hardware solutions within the country. Building indigenous semiconductor and sensor capability is critical for enhancing India's technological sovereignty and defense sector capabilities.

geopolitics.headline: Germany Marks Unity Day in Delhi, Celebrating 75 Years of India Ties
geopolitics.text: Germany celebrated its Unity Day in New Delhi, marking 75 years of diplomatic relations with India. The milestone highlights deepening bilateral cooperation in trade, green technology, and skilled labor mobility. Strengthening ties with Europe's largest economy supports India's strategic diversification and economic growth agenda.

geopolitics.headline: PM Narendra Modi Holds Bilateral Talks at India AI Impact Summit
geopolitics.text: Prime Minister Narendra Modi held bilateral meetings with global leaders on the sidelines of the India AI Impact Summit in New Delhi. The discussions focused on international AI governance, technology transfers, and strategic partnerships. Positioning India at the center of global AI diplomacy reinforces the nation's push to become a technological leader.
